question: us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.inclusionary-requirement
definition: no + preempts true = state law bars local governments from requiring below-market (affordable) units in new developments; yes + preempts false = state law requires below-market units in new developments statewide or requires localities to plan for them through set-asides; no + preempts false = no statewide requirement and localities may adopt their own (including where only rental set-asides are limited by a rent-control ban or where authority is conditioned).
summarySource: State code pages fetched 9/28/2026 (Ariz., Tex., Wis., Kan., Mont., Idaho, Mo., Cal., Or., Fla., Mass., D.C., N.J. P.L.2008 c.46, Colo. HB21-1117); Grounded Solutions Network inclusionaryhousing.org legal-issues page (undated, pre-2021) as the weak absence tracker.

US-AZ.note: Cities may not impose any requirement that sets the sale or lease price of a home or reserves it for a class of residents; voluntary incentives and density bonuses remain allowed.

US-CA.note: State law authorizes cities to require affordable rental units in new development (AB 1505); it requires affordable units statewide only in the coastal zone, where feasible (Gov. Code § 65590(d)).

US-CO.note: HB21-1117 confirmed local authority to require new affordable units, exempting such rules from the rent-control ban if they offer alternatives to on-site units; before then rental inclusionary rules were preempted.

conflicts.readings: Grounded Solutions lists Idaho among states prohibiting at least some mandatory inclusionary housing (preempts true); the fetched statute (Idaho Code § 55-306) bars only rent regulation, leaving for-sale requirements open (preempts false).
Grounded Solutions (undated, pre-2021) lists Colorado as prohibiting some mandatory inclusionary housing; HB21-1117 (effective 9/7/2021) restored the authority.
Grounded Solutions does not list Montana, but Mont. Code Ann. § 76-2-302(6) (2021) bars fees and dedications for income-restricted housing; whether it reaches on-site set-asides is not explicit.
